connectionSpecification.description: Reads Google Ads accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, daily performance and custom GAQL queries from the Google Ads API.

child_customer_ids.description: Client accounts of the managers in customer_ids to read; empty reads all enabled ones.
child_customer_ids.title: Child Customer IDs

client_id.description: Client ID of the Google Cloud OAuth client the refresh token was issued to.
client_id.title: OAuth Client ID

client_secret.description: Client secret of the OAuth client.
client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret

custom_queries.description: Each query becomes a stream with its name. A query that selects segments.date is incremental by day. Select customer.id to tell accounts apart.
custom_queries.title: Custom GAQL Queries

customer_ids.description: Accounts to read, with or without dashes. A manager account reads its enabled client accounts.
customer_ids.title: Customer IDs

developer_token.description: Google Ads API developer token of your manager account, with Basic or Standard access to read production accounts. Sent in the developer-token header.
developer_token.title: Developer Token

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose performance is read; empty reads up to today (UTC).
end_date.title: End Date

login_customer_id.description: Manager account the credentials reach the customers through, sent as the login-customer-id header. Empty uses the manager in customer_ids for its clients.
login_customer_id.title: Login Customer ID

lookback_days.description: Days before the saved date an incremental read starts again, since conversions are still attributed to past days.
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token with the https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords scope.
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose performance is read. Google Ads keeps 37 months; earlier days are not requested.
start_date.title: Start Date

connectionSpecification.title: Google Ads Source Spec
